name: Sunset longtail and plankton kayak

seo.title: Plankton Kayak at Sunset, Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: A private longtail through the Koh Lanta mangrove, a barbecue at sunset on Ko Kwang headland, then a night kayak among glowing plankton. 6,000 THB for 1 to 4.

h1: Sunset longtail and night kayak with the glowing plankton
lead: Your own longtail through the Thung Yee Peng mangrove in the late afternoon, a barbecue on Ko Kwang headland as the sun goes down, then a kayak in the dark to look for the plankton that glows in the water.
promise: Sunset barbecue, then a night kayak among glowing plankton

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng, east coast of Koh Lanta

facts.label: Back at the pier
facts.value: 20:00, then the transfer to your hotel

facts.label: Village entrance fee
facts.value: 40 THB per adult, 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, not included

options.label: Private longtail, sunset barbecue and plankton kayak
options.note: The price covers the boat for 1 to 4 people. Each extra adult adds 1,200 THB and each extra child from 4 to 11 adds 600 THB, so 5 adults pay 7,200 THB.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel and the drive to Thung Yee Peng community pier.
Your longtail leaves the pier for Ko Kwang headland.
A slow cruise through the mangrove forest. Look out for macaques and the local birds.
Barbecue dinner on Ko Kwang headland at sunset, with seasonal fruit and drinks.
The longtail takes you to the plankton area.
Into the kayaks in the dark, to look for the glowing plankton.
Back at the pier and the transfer to your hotel.

included: The longtail for your group only

beforeYouBook.children: The longtail is for your group only. Beyond the first four people, children from 4 to 11 pay 600 THB instead of 1,200 THB.

faq.q: How much for a bigger group?
faq.a: 6,000 THB covers the boat for up to 4 people. Each extra adult adds 1,200 THB and each extra child from 4 to 11 adds 600 THB.
A barbecue on Ko Kwang headland at sunset, with seasonal fruit, drinking water and drinks.

faq.q: How is it different from the sunset dinner raft?
faq.a: The raft drifts through the mangrove with a seafood dinner on board. Here a longtail takes you out to the headland for a barbecue, and you paddle a kayak yourself to find the plankton.

faq.q: Is the village entrance fee included?
faq.a: No. Thung Yee Peng village charges 40 THB per adult and 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, paid on the spot.
